quickAnswer: İzmir business travel connects foreign buyers to high-export manufacturing in İAOSB (Çiğli), Manisa OSB, and Denizli via Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB) and modern Aegean motorways. body.text: Which industries (machinery, olive oil, wine, tech, logistics) anchor İzmir and Manisa?

İzmir and neighboring Manisa form the Aegean's primary export corridor, anchored by precision machinery, automotive sub-industries, home appliances, renewable energy equipment, software technoparks, container port logistics, and specialty agrifood including olive oil, dried fruit, and estate wine serving European and global buyers.

Established in 1990 in Çiğli, the [İzmir Atatürk Organized Industrial Zone (İAOSB)](https://www.iaosb.org.tr/home) hosts hundreds of export-oriented factories spanning machinery, metalworking, plastics, textiles, electronics, and food processing. Just 40 minutes northeast over the Sabuncubeli Tunnel, [Manisa Organized Industrial Park (MOSB)](https://www.mosb.org.tr/en/home/)—operating since 1963—anchors white goods, automotive components, and electrical manufacturing with dedicated energy and rail freight infrastructure. Meanwhile, İzmir's Alsancak and Aliağa ports handle Aegean container exports, while Urla and Kemalpaşa drive boutique olive oil, wine, and agritech sourcing.
Where should business visitors stay relative to AOSB and ADB airport?

Stay in Alsancak or Bayraklı if you are splitting appointments between İAOSB (Çiğli), Manisa OSB, and city-center trading offices. Choose Gaziemir only when your visits center on the Aegean Free Zone (ESBAŞ) or require a 06:00 flight out of İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB).

[İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB)](https://izmirairport.com/en/arrival-guide) sits in Gaziemir, roughly 18 kilometers south of Konak and Alsancak (25–35 minutes by car outside rush hour). Bayraklı's modern business towers sit directly on the northern ring-road junction, cutting morning drives to İAOSB down to 20 minutes and to Manisa OSB down to 35 minutes. Alsancak offers the widest choice of international five-star hotels and waterfront dining for evening supplier dinners, while adding only 10 to 15 minutes to northern industrial commutes.

body.text: How do you pair a 2-day business visit with Urla or Alaçatı?

Schedule your factory audits in İAOSB, Manisa, or Gaziemir on Wednesday and Thursday while staying in central İzmir, then transfer 45 minutes west on Thursday evening to Urla for vineyard dining and coastal downtime—or continue 30 minutes further along the O-32 motorway to Alaçatı for Friday and Saturday.

Urla combines agrifood producers and boutique wineries with a 40-minute motorway drive back to ADB airport. From May to October, Alaçatı adds coastal stone hotels and dining, though July and August bring peak crowds and higher rates. A Friday morning Urla estate visit before an afternoon ADB flight fits neatly into a short trip.
What private transport options connect İzmir to Denizli and Manisa?

Hire a licensed D2/TÜRSAB chauffeur-driven Mercedes V-Class or Sprinter VIP for intercity factory runs from İzmir to Manisa (40–50 minutes via the Sabuncubeli Tunnel) and Denizli (2.5–3 hours via the İzmir–Aydın–Denizli motorway corridor), allowing buyers to work between plants without navigating unfamiliar toll highways.

Denizli anchors Türkiye's home-textile, marble, and cable sectors roughly 230 kilometers southeast of ADB. Using the [Aydın–Denizli Motorway corridor](https://aydindenizliotoyolu.com.tr/Content/files/Surdurulebilirlik/en/Too_En.pdf) and private transfers ([İzmir–Denizli route reference](https://utopiaizmirtransfer.com/en/popular-routes/izmir-denizli-transfer/)), a 07:30 İzmir departure reaches Denizli OSB by 10:15 for two plant audits. For groups of 6–14, apply our [corporate delegation transport guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/corporate-delegation-istanbul).

faq.q: How long is the drive from İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB) to Manisa OSB?
faq.a: The drive takes approximately 50 to 65 minutes via the İzmir ring road (O-30) and the Sabuncubeli Tunnel, depending on weekday commuter traffic.

faq.q: Can foreign buyers visit both İAOSB and Manisa OSB in a single workday?
faq.a: Yes. Because İAOSB (Çiğli) and Manisa OSB lie on the northern industrial axis, a private driver can move your team between the two zones in 40 to 50 minutes, making two morning visits in Çiğli and one afternoon visit in Manisa realistic.

faq.q: Is there a direct flight from Europe to İzmir (ADB), or should we connect via Istanbul?
faq.a: Direct seasonal and year-round flights operate between major German, UK, and European hubs and ADB, while Turkish Airlines runs frequent 1-hour domestic connections from Istanbul Airport (IST) throughout the day.

faq.q: When is the best time of year to combine İzmir factory visits with Urla or Alaçatı?
faq.a: April through June and September through November deliver mild Aegean weather, active harvest or olive-pressing seasons, and far calmer hotel pricing than peak July–August summer holidays.

faq.q: Should textile buyers fly into Denizli Çardak Airport (DNZ) or drive from İzmir (ADB)?
faq.a: If Denizli is your sole destination, flying IST to DNZ saves road time; if you are combining İzmir, Manisa, and Denizli in one Aegean sourcing loop, flying into ADB with a private chauffeur is more flexible.
